name: MARKET_AGREEMENT_CALIBRATION
problem: Agreement currently collapses cohesion score and evidence confidence into one LOW/HIGH presentation. The fallback score for no cohesion data is 50, so an unmeasured reading can be displayed as HIGH under the current threshold.

criticalFinding.meaning: 24 of the 49 current HIGH Agreement readings in this sample were actually zero-confidence fallback 50s rather than measured high agreement.

selectedArchitecture.scoreMeaning: measured market/book cohesion strength on the existing 0-100 scale
selectedArchitecture.confidenceMeaning: amount of evidence supporting that score on the existing 0-100 confidence scale
selectedArchitecture.highEligibilityRule: Agreement may never qualify as HIGH when confidence == 0.
selectedArchitecture.unmeasuredNumericCompatibility: Retain neutral score 50 internally where needed for arithmetic compatibility, but expose the reading as UNMEASURED and do not treat the numeric 50 as a measured Agreement observation.

rejectedArchitectures.SCORE_SHRINK: Rejected because confidence-based shrinking compresses measured Agreement around 50 and still represents missing evidence as a numeric observation.
rejectedArchitectures.SCORE_TIMES_CONFIDENCE: Rejected because blending score and confidence changes the semantic meaning of Agreement and makes evidence quantity indistinguishable from actual cohesion.
rejectedArchitectures.THIRD_VIG_GRAPHIC_STATE_NOW: Deferred because Step 3 should not expand the existing 18-graphic VIG architecture before combined calibration.

notes: This locks the Step 3 calibration decision only; the live terminal Agreement behavior remains unchanged until the production rollout step.
The final LOW/HIGH score threshold and presentation treatment of UNMEASURED are intentionally deferred to Step 4, where Heat, Pressure, and Agreement will be evaluated together.
